title: 2019 年全国硕士研究生招生考试 英语（二）

sections.title: Section I　完形填空
sections.dir: Read the following text. Choose the best word(s) for each numbered blank and mark A, B, C or D on the ANSWER SHEET. (10 points)
sections.note: 主线：每日称重为何弊大于利、作者如何改成每月两次。1、8、10、18 四处最易凭语感顺读而错。

paras.en: Weighing yourself regularly is a wonderful way to stay aware of any significant weight fluctuations. 1 , when done too often, this habit can sometimes hurt more than it 2 .
paras.zh: 定期称体重是随时察觉体重有无明显波动的好办法。1 ，但如果称得太频繁，这个习惯有时造成的伤害反而超过它 2 的益处。

paras.en: As for me, weighing myself every day caused me to shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active, to focusing 3 on the scale. That was bad to my overall fitness goals. I had gained weight in the form of muscle mass, but thinking only of 4 the number on the scale, I altered my training program. That conflicted with how I needed to train to 5 my goals.
paras.zh: 就我而言，每天称重使我从关注“整体健康、身体活跃”转向 3 盯着体重秤。这对我的整体健身目标不利。我本来是以肌肉量的形式增加了体重，但因为只想着 4 秤上的数字，我改变了训练方案。这与我为 5 目标所需要的训练方式相冲突。

paras.en: I also found that weighing myself daily did not provide an accurate 6 of the hard work and progress I was making in the gym. It takes about three weeks to a month to notice significant changes in your weight 7 altering your training program. The most 8 changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
paras.zh: 我还发现，每天称重并不能准确 6 我在健身房付出的努力和取得的进步。改变训练方案后，大约要三周到一个月，才能在体重上看到明显变化。最 8 的变化会体现在技术水平、力量以及减少的围度上。

paras.en: For these 9 , I stopped weighing myself every day and switched to a bimonthly weighing schedule 10 . Since weight loss is not my goal, it is less important for me to 11 my weight each week. Weighing every other week allows me to observe and 12 any significant weight changes. That tells me whether I need to 13 my training program.
paras.zh: 由于这些 9 ，我不再每天称重，10 改为每月称两次。既然减重不是我的目标，每周 11 体重对我就没那么重要。每隔一周称一次，让我得以观察并 12 体重的任何显著变化。这能告诉我是否需要 13 训练方案。

paras.en: I use my bimonthly weigh-in 14 to get information about my nutrition as well. If my training intensity remains the same, but I'm constantly 15 and dropping weight, this is a 16 that I need to increase my daily caloric intake.
paras.zh: 我也用每月两次称重的 14 来了解自己的营养状况。如果训练强度保持不变，我却总是 15 、体重下降，这就是一个 16 ：我需要增加每日热量摄入。

paras.en: The 17 to stop weighing myself every day has done wonders for my overall health, fitness and well-being. I'm experiencing increased zeal for working out since I no longer carry the burden of a 18 morning weigh-in. I've also experienced greater success in achieving my specific fitness goals, 19 I'm training according to those goals, not the numbers on a scale.
paras.zh: 停止每天称重的 17 对我的整体健康、体能和幸福感都产生了奇效。由于不再背负早晨称重那 18 的负担，我锻炼的热情更高了。我在实现具体健身目标方面也更为成功，19 我是按照这些目标训练，而不是照着秤上的数字训练。

paras.en: Rather than 20 over the scale, turn your focus to how you look, feel, how your clothes fit and your overall energy level.
paras.zh: 与其 20 体重秤，不如把注意力转向你的外表和感受、衣服是否合身，以及整体的精力水平。

items.exp: 定位首段第一、二句：首句夸定期称重是 a wonderful way，本句却说做得太频繁 can sometimes hurt more than it...，前后是转折关系，且空后有逗号作插入语，故 However。Therefore 表因果，会把“好处”直接推成“坏处”；Besides 表递进；Otherwise 表“否则”，要求前句为条件或禁令，此处均不成立。
定位 hurt more than it ___。than 前后应是同一语义场内并列的动词，与 hurt（有害）相对的正是 help（有益），且首句 a wonderful way 已给出正面评价，故 helps，即“害大于利”。reduces（减少）、warns（警告）无法与 hurt 构成利弊对照；cares 与“称重”根本不搭。

定位 shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active, to focusing ___ on the scale。从“整体健康、身体活跃”转到“只看秤上的数字”，是范围由全面收缩为单一，故 solely。initially 只表时间先后，不能体现“片面化”这一弊端；occasionally 与 every day 矛盾；formally 意为“形式上”，与“只关注数字”不合。

定位 but thinking only of ___ the number on the scale, I altered my training program。but 前说“我以肌肉的形式增重了”，but 后应转向相反方向——减重；改训练方案的目的就是把秤上的数字降下来，故 lowering。recording（记录）只是中性动作，解释不了“为什么改方案”；accepting（接受）与“改方案”矛盾；explaining 更无从谈起。
定位 That conflicted with how I needed to train to ___ my goals。冲突发生在“训练方式”与“目标”之间，训练是为了“达成”目标，reach one's goals 是固定搭配。set（设定）与 modify（修改）都把宾语变成“目标本身”，逻辑上应是先有目标、再谈训练方式；review（回顾）不含“实现”义。

定位 did not provide an accurate ___ of the hard work and progress I was making。称重给出的是对努力与进步的“呈现、反映”，depiction 最合；下文说三周到一个月才看得到变化，正说明数字无法如实“描绘”过程。definition 是对事物本质的界定，与“锻炼成果”不搭；distribution（分布）、prediction（预测）离得更远。

定位 notice significant changes in your weight ___ altering your training program。空缺需解释“为什么变化要等三周到一个月”，即变化是“由改变训练方案引起的”，due to 表原因。regardless of（不管）会切断这一因果；aside from（除……之外）把改方案说成“额外之事”，与全段“改方案→才有变化”的链条相反。

定位 The most ___ changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost。上句说体重变化要等三周到一个月，本句对比“先看到的变化在技能、力量、围度”，突出快慢，故 immediate。precise（精确）是最大干扰项：它看似能修饰 changes，但本段谈的是“变化何时显现”而非“数据是否精细”；orderly、rigid 与 changes 不搭配。
定位 For these ___, I stopped weighing myself every day。these 回指上文罗列的多条弊端（注意力偏移、数字不准、反应滞后），是“原因”，For these reasons 为固定表达。claims（主张）与 judgments（判断）都是主观论断，不能解释“因此改变做法”；methods（方法）也不能与 For these 连用表示因果。

定位 stopped weighing myself every day and switched to a bimonthly weighing schedule ___。前句“不再每天称”，本句“改用每月两次”，是替代关系，且 instead 置于句末表“转而、取而代之”。again 表重复，与“换方式”相反；though 作副词虽可置句末，但此处两句是顺承的取舍，不是让步；indeed 只表强调。

定位 it is less important for me to ___ my weight each week。既然减重不是目标，每周“追踪”体重就没那么重要；track 与首段 stay aware of any significant weight fluctuations 呼应。overlook（忽视）与后文“观察变化”自相矛盾；conceal 是“对他人隐瞒”，report 是“向上汇报”，都不合自我监测的语境。
定位 observe and ___ any significant weight changes。观察之后要弄清变化从何而来（是否训练不当），account for 正是“解释、说明”。depend on（取决于）会把主宾关系颠倒；“approve of”意为赞成，与“体重变化”不搭；hold onto 意为“保住”，与“解释变化”无关。

定位 That tells me whether I need to ___ my training program。根据称重结果判断是否“调整”训练方案，与第二段 I altered my training program 构成同义复现，故 adjust。confirm（确认）与 whether 连用变成“确认方案是否有效”，与“按变化改方案”的逻辑错位；share、prepare 均与“改方案”无关。
定位 I use my bimonthly weigh-in ___ to get information about my nutrition。weigh-in 是“称一次体重”，能提供的是“称重结果”，故 results。features（特征）、rules（规则）、tests（检测）都不能指“称一次得到的数值”，其中 tests 更是把“称重”误当成“体检”。
定位 constantly ___ and dropping weight。空缺与 dropping weight 并列，且下文对策是 increase my daily caloric intake，说明症状是“总饿”，故 hungry。bored、anxious、sick 都可能与体重下降同现，但都推不出“增加热量摄入”这一具体建议；sick 更会引出“就医”而非“加餐”。
定位 this is a ___ that I need to increase my daily caloric intake。that 从句具体说明空格所指，两者是同位关系：“常饿 + 掉秤”是“需要加餐”的迹象，故 sign。principle（原理）、belief（信念）都是主观认知，不能由身体表现推出；secret 与“需要被发现的事”不符。

定位 The ___ to stop weighing myself every day has done wonders。不定式 to stop... 说明这是权衡之后付诸行动的“决定”，且下文全在讲这一决定带来的好处，故 decision。wish（愿望）不含“已实施”；request（请求）无人向作者请求；necessity（必要性）无法与 has done wonders 这样的“既成效果”搭配。

定位 I no longer carry the burden of a ___ morning weigh-in。称重之所以成为 burden，是因为天天称却看不到变化（第三段），结果令人失望，故 disappointing。surprising 与“负担”的情感色彩相反；restricting（限制性的）修饰“称重”不通；consuming 虽可修饰行为，却无法与上文“看不到变化”的失落衔接。

定位 I've also experienced greater success in achieving my specific fitness goals, ___ I'm training according to those goals。后半句是“取得更大成功”的原因（我按目标而非数字训练），故 because。if 表条件，而“按目标训练”已是事实；unless 表否定条件；until 表时间终点，都读不通。

定位 Rather than ___ over the scale, turn your focus to how you look, feel...。obsess over sth 是固定搭配，意为“对……过分挂心”，与第二段 focusing solely on the scale 首尾呼应。dominate 的宾语应是人或局面，不能是 scale；puzzle over 是“苦思不解”，与“盯着数字计较”不是一回事；triumph over 的对象应是困难。

sections.title: Text 1　内疚感的价值
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：内疚不是坏情绪，适量内疚能维系合作。23 题的 binary、24 题的 either...or 是两处定位锚点。

paras.en: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms. Children aren't born knowing how to say "I'm sorry"; rather, they learn over time that such statements appease parents and friends - and their own consciences. This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing.
paras.zh: 与悲伤、恐惧、愤怒等所谓基本情绪不同，内疚出现得稍晚一些，它与孩子对社会规范和道德规范的逐步理解相伴而生。孩子并非生来就会说“对不起”；他们是在成长中慢慢懂得，这样的话能安抚父母和朋友——以及自己的良心。正因如此，研究者普遍认为，所谓道德意义上的内疚，只要分量适度，就是一件好事。

paras.en: In the popular imagination, of course, guilt still gets a bad rap. It is deeply uncomfortable - it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones. Yet this understanding is outdated. "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Yaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary — feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another. Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities. Too much happiness can be destructive.
paras.zh: 当然，在大众想象中，内疚的名声依然不佳。它让人极不舒服——那种感觉，相当于穿上一件塞满石头的夹克。但这种理解已经过时了。弗吉尼亚大学心理学研究者阿姆里莎·亚什（Amrisha Yaish）说：“人们正在对内疚是什么、内疚能起什么作用做一种复兴式的重新思考。”她补充说，这种重新思考属于一个更大的认识：情绪并非非此即彼——在一种情境中有益的感受，在另一种情境中可能有害。比如嫉妒和愤怒，可能正是演化出来提醒我们注意重要的不平等。快乐过多也可能具有破坏性。

paras.en: And guilt, by prompting us to think more deeply about our goodness, can encourage humans to make up for errors and fix relationships. Guilt, in other words, can help hold a cooperative species together. It is a kind of social glue.
paras.zh: 而内疚，由于促使我们更深入地思考自己的善，能鼓励人去弥补过错、修复关系。换句话说，内疚有助于把一个合作性的物种维系在一起。它是一种社会黏合剂。

paras.en: Viewed in this light, guilt is an opportunity. Work by Tina Malti, a psychology professor at the University of Toronto, suggests that guilt may compensate for an emotional deficiency. In a number of studies, Malti and others have shown that guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing. Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses. And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt.
paras.zh: 从这个角度看，内疚是一种机会。多伦多大学心理学教授蒂娜·马尔蒂（Tina Malti）的研究表明，内疚可以弥补某种情感上的缺失。在多项研究中，马尔蒂等人发现，内疚与同情可能是通往合作与分享的两条不同路径。有些同情心较弱的孩子，会通过体验更多内疚来弥补这一不足，而内疚能约束他们更具恶意的冲动。反之亦然：高度的同情可以替代较低的内疚。

paras.en: In a 2014 study, for example, Malti looked at 244 children. Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions. Then the kids were handed chocolate coins, and given a chance to share them with an anonymous child. For the low-sympathy kids, how much they shared appeared to turn on how inclined they were to feel guilty. The guilt-prone ones shared more, even though they hadn't magically become more sympathetic to the other child's deprivation.
paras.zh: 例如在 2014 年的一项研究中，马尔蒂观察了 244 名儿童。她借助照护者的评估和孩子的自我观察，给每个孩子的整体同情水平，以及他们在道德上越界之后产生负面情绪的倾向打分。随后，孩子们得到巧克力硬币，并有机会与一位不认识的小朋友分享。对同情心较弱的孩子来说，分享多少似乎取决于他们有多容易感到内疚。容易内疚的孩子分享得更多，尽管他们并没有神奇地对另一个孩子的匮乏变得更富同情。

paras.en: "That's good news," Malti says. "We can be prosocial because we caused harm and we feel regret."
paras.zh: “这是好消息，”马尔蒂说，“我们可以因为自己造成了伤害、感到后悔，而做出亲社会的行为。”

items.stem: Researchers think that guilt can be a good thing because it may help
items.exp: 定位首段末句 researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing。往前一句：孩子学会说“对不起”，是为了安抚父母、朋友和自己的良心——内疚与“对社会规范和道德规范的把握”同步生长，故“有助于孩子的道德发展”。A 把基本情绪（悲伤、恐惧、愤怒）说成内疚要调节的对象，方向正相反；B 的智力、D 的“强化积极情绪”均无依据。

items.stem: According to Paragraph 2, many people still consider guilt to be
items.exp: 定位第二段 It is deeply uncomfortable - it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones。像穿着塞满石头的夹克，正是“沉重、难以承受”，burdensome 为同义替换。deceptive（欺骗性的）针对“内疚会骗人”，文中无此意；addictive（令人上瘾）、inexcusable（不可原谅）属无中生有，文中只强调“不舒服”。

items.stem: Yaish holds that the rethinking about guilt comes from an awareness that
opts: an emotion can play opposing roles
items.exp: 定位第二段 adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary — feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another。同一种情绪在此处有益、在彼处有害，即“一种情绪可以扮演相反角色”。A 的 context-independent 恰与 in one context 相反，原文强调的是情境依赖；B、C 把“情绪有正反两面”偷换成“社会建构”“有益健康”。

items.stem: Malti and others have shown that cooperation and sharing
opts: can result from either sympathy or guilt
may be the outcome of impulsive acts
items.exp: 定位第四段 guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing。两条通路即“同情”或“内疚”都能通向合作与分享，故 can result from either sympathy or guilt。A 把“内疚弥补情感缺失”偷换成“合作弥补情感缺失”，主客颠倒；C 的 emotional satisfaction、D 的 impulsive acts 文中均未提及，原文只说内疚能约束冲动。

items.stem: The word "transgressions" (Line 4, Para.5) is closest in meaning to
items.exp: 定位第五段 tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions。紧接着的例子是“分巧克力时是否愿意分享”，文末又说 we caused harm and we feel regret，可见 transgressions 指“道德上的越界、做错事”，故 wrongdoings。teachings（教导）方向相反；restrictions（限制）是外部约束，而此处说的是自己犯错后的负面情绪；discussions 完全无关。

sections.title: Text 2　加州森林碳计划
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：为让森林长期固碳，加州反而要“先减后增”。28 题 thin out、29 题 prioritize 是两个定位点。

paras.en: Forests give us shade, quiet and one of the harder challenges in the fight against climate change. Even as we humans count on forests to soak up a good share of the carbon dioxide we produce, we are threatening their ability to do so. The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb.
paras.zh: 森林给我们阴凉、宁静，也给我们对抗气候变化中最棘手的挑战之一。就在人类指望森林吸收我们排放的相当一部分二氧化碳时，我们却在削弱它们这样做的能力。我们正在加速的气候变化，有朝一日可能让我们面对的森林排放的碳多于它们吸收的碳。

paras.en: Thankfully, there is a way out of this trap — but it involves striking a subtle balance. Helping forests flourish as valuable "carbon sinks" long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now. California is leading the way, as it does on so many climate efforts, in figuring out the details.
paras.zh: 所幸，这个困局有出路——但这需要拿捏一种微妙的平衡。要让森林作为宝贵的“碳汇”长久繁茂，眼下也许反而需要降低它们吸收碳的能力。加州正在带头摸索其中的细节，正如它在许多气候事务上的做法一样。

paras.en: The state's proposed Forest Carbon Plan aims to double efforts to thin out young trees and clear brush in parts of the forest. This temporarily lowers carbon-carrying capacity. But the remaining trees draw a greater share of the available moisture, so they grow and thrive, restoring the forest's capacity to pull carbon from the air. Healthy trees are also better able to fend off insects. The landscape is rendered less easily burnable. Even in the event of a fire, fewer trees are consumed.
paras.zh: 该州提出的《森林碳计划》打算加倍努力，在部分林区疏伐幼树、清除灌木。这会暂时降低森林承载碳的能力。但保留下来的树木能分到更多可利用的水分，因而生长旺盛，恢复森林从空气中吸收碳的能力。健康的树木也更能抵御虫害，整体景观因此不易燃烧。即便发生火灾，被烧毁的树木也会更少。

paras.en: The need for such planning is increasingly urgent. Already, since 2010, drought and insects have killed over 100 million trees in California, most of them in 2016 alone, and wildfires have burned hundreds of thousands of acres.
paras.zh: 此类规划正变得越来越紧迫。自 2010 年以来，干旱和虫害已在加州杀死超过一亿棵树，其中大部分是 2016 年一年之内死掉的；山火则烧毁了数十万英亩林地。

paras.en: California plans to treat 35,000 acres of forest a year by 2020, and 60,000 by 2030 — financed from the proceeds of the state's emissions-permit auctions. That's only a small share of the total acreage that could benefit, about half a million acres in all, so it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought.
paras.zh: 加州计划到 2020 年每年治理 3.5 万英亩森林，到 2030 年每年治理 6 万英亩——资金来自该州排放许可拍卖所得。这仅占可能受益林地总面积的一小部分（总共约五十万英亩），因此必须优先处理火灾或干旱风险最大的区域，这一点至关重要。

paras.en: The strategy also aims to ensure that carbon in woody material removed from the forests is locked away in the form of solid lumber or burned as biofuel in vehicles that would otherwise run on fossil fuels. New research on transportation biofuels is already under way.
paras.zh: 该战略还力求确保：从森林中移出的木质材料所含的碳，或以实木木材的形式被封存，或作为生物燃料供原本烧化石燃料的车辆使用。关于交通生物燃料的新研究已经在进行中。

paras.en: State governments are well accustomed to managing forests, but traditionally they've focused on wildlife, watersheds and opportunities for recreation. Only recently have they come to see the vital part forests will have to play in storing carbon. California's plan, which is expected to be finalized by the governor next year, should serve as a model.
paras.zh: 州政府一向擅长管理森林，但传统上关注的是野生动物、流域和休闲游憩机会。直到最近，他们才认识到森林在固碳方面必须发挥的关键作用。加州这项计划预计明年由州长最终敲定，应当成为范本。

items.stem: By saying "one of the harder challenges," the author implies that
opts: global climate change may get out of control
forests may become a potential threat
items.exp: 定位首段首句与末句：森林是对抗气候变化中“较难的挑战”之一，因为 the climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb。森林可能从“碳汇”变成“碳源”，即成为潜在威胁。A 把“气候变化失控”当成森林的挑战，偷换了主体；B 的误解、C 的极端天气文中均未提。

items.stem: To maintain forests as valuable "carbon sinks," we may need to
opts: preserve the diversity of species in them
accelerate the growth of young trees
strike a balance among different plants
items.exp: 定位第二段 Helping forests flourish as valuable "carbon sinks" long into the future may require reducing their capacity to absorb carbon now，题干与原文几乎逐字对应，故 D。C 是把 striking a subtle balance 误读为“物种间平衡”，原文的平衡指“眼下吸碳少一点、将来固碳多一点”；B 的“加速幼树生长”与第三段“疏伐幼树”正好相反；A 文中未提。

items.stem: California's Forest Carbon Plan endeavors to
opts: reduce the density of some of its forests
find more effective ways to kill insects
restore its forests quickly after wildfires
items.exp: 定位第三段 The state's proposed Forest Carbon Plan aims to double efforts to thin out young trees and clear brush in parts of the forest。thin out 即“疏伐、间伐”，就是降低部分林区的树木密度，故 B。A 的“抗旱树种”文中未提，抗旱只是选点依据；C 与“健康树木能抵御虫害”相反；D 的“灾后快速恢复”也不是计划内容，计划讲的是“降低可燃性”。

items.stem: What is essential to California's plan according to Paragraph 5?
opts: To handle the areas in serious danger first.
To carry it out before the year of 2020.
items.exp: 定位第五段末句 it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought。prioritize 即“优先处理”，与 handle...first 同义，故 A。D 是最大干扰项：资金已由排放许可拍卖解决（financed from the proceeds...），是既定条件而非“关键”；B 把 2020 年这个治理进度节点当成前提；C 的“完善拍卖制度”文中无据。

items.stem: The author's attitude to California's plan can best be described as
items.exp: 定位第二段 California is leading the way 与末段 California's plan... should serve as a model。“带头”“应成为范本”都是明确肯定，故 supportive。D 是最强干扰项：文中确有“需拿捏微妙平衡”“要优先处理高风险区”之说，但那是计划本身的审慎设计，不是作者对计划的保留态度；A、B 与“范本”的评价不符。

sections.title: Text 3　美国农场的用工短缺
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：移民政策卡住农场用工，机械化也接不上。33 题问“被反复讨论的方案”，不是作者主张。

paras.en: American farmers have been complaining of labor shortages for several years. The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.
paras.zh: 美国农民抱怨劳动力短缺已有数年。如果不对农场工人的移民规则做彻底改革，这些抱怨不太可能停止。

paras.en: Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa for agricultural workers that would let foreign workers stay longer in the U.S. and change jobs within the industry. If this doesn't change, American businesses, communities, and consumers will be the losers.
paras.zh: 国会一直阻挠为农业工人设立一种更简便的签证，这种签证本可让外国工人更久地留在美国，并能在行业内更换工作。如果这一点不改变，美国的商界、社区和消费者都将是输家。

paras.en: Perhaps half of U.S. farm laborers are undocumented immigrants. As fewer such workers enter the country, the characteristics of the agricultural workforce are changing. Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single. They're also aging. At the start of this century, about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35. Now more than half are. And picking crops is hard on older bodies. One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage remains as implausible as it's been all along: Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm.
paras.zh: 美国农场工人中或许有一半是无证移民。随着这类工人入境减少，农业劳动力的特征正在改变。如今的农场工人虽然仍以墨西哥出生者为主，但更倾向于定居而非流动，更可能已婚而非单身。他们也在老龄化：本世纪初，约三分之一的作物工人年龄超过 35 岁，如今这一比例已超过一半。而采摘作物对年长者的身体来说十分吃力。针对这一短缺，一个长期被反复讨论的对策始终和过去一样不切实际：美国本土工人不会回到农场。

paras.en: Mechanization isn't the answer, either — not yet, at least. Production of corn, cotton, rice, soybeans, and wheat has been largely mechanized, but many high-value, labor-intensive crops, such as strawberries, need labor. Even dairy farms, where robots do a small share of milking, have a long way to go before they're automated.
paras.zh: 机械化也不是答案——至少目前还不是。玉米、棉花、水稻、大豆和小麦的生产已基本实现机械化，但许多高价值、劳动密集的作物（如草莓）仍需要人力。即便是由机器人承担小部分挤奶工作的奶牛场，距离完全自动化也还有很长的路要走。

paras.en: As a result, farms have grown increasingly reliant on temporary guest workers using the H-2A visa to fill the gaps in the workforce. Starting around 2012, requests for the visas rose sharply; from 2011 to 2016 the number of visas issued more than doubled.
paras.zh: 结果，农场越来越依赖持 H-2A 签证的临时客工来填补劳动力缺口。大约从 2012 年起，此类签证的申请量急剧上升；2011 年到 2016 年，签发的签证数量增加了一倍多。

paras.en: The H-2A visa has no numerical cap, unlike the H-2B visa for nonagricultural work, which is limited to 66,000 a year. Even so, employers complain they aren't given all the workers they need. The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable. One survey found that bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late. The shortage is compounded by federal immigration raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground.
paras.zh: H-2A 签证没有数量上限，这与每年限额 6.6 万份的非农业工作 H-2B 签证不同。即便如此，雇主仍抱怨他们拿不到所需的全部工人。申请程序繁琐、昂贵且不可靠。一项调查发现，官僚拖延使 H-2A 工人平均晚到岗 22 天。联邦移民突查又使短缺雪上加霜：一些工人被带走，另一些则转入地下。

paras.en: In a 2012 survey, 71 percent of tree-fruit growers and almost 80 percent of raisin and berry growers said they were short of labor. Some western farmers have responded by moving operations to Mexico. From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported. Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent.
paras.zh: 在 2012 年的一项调查中，71% 的核果种植者和近 80% 的葡萄干与浆果种植者表示劳动力不足。一些西部农场主已通过把生产经营迁往墨西哥来应对。1998 年至 2000 年，美国人消费的水果中有 14.5% 依靠进口。十多年后，进口份额已达 25.8%。

paras.en: In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.
paras.zh: 实际上，美国要么进口食物，要么进口采摘食物的工人。

items.stem: What problem should be addressed according to the first two paragraphs?
opts: Discrimination against foreign workers in the U.S.
Biased laws in favor of some American businesses.
Flaws in U.S. immigration rules for farm workers.
Decline of job opportunities in U.S. agriculture.
items.exp: 定位第一段 without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers 与第二段 Congress has obstructed efforts to create a more straightforward visa。两段都在说“农场工人移民规则”有缺陷、需要改革，故 C。A 的“歧视外国工人”文中未提；B 把“国会阻挠改革”说成“法律偏袒某些企业”，方向错；D 与“劳动力短缺”正好相反。

items.stem: One trouble with U.S. agricultural workforce is
opts: the rising number of illegal immigrants
the high mobility of crop workers
the aging of immigrant farm workers
items.exp: 定位第三段 They're also aging... about one-third of crop workers were over the age of 35. Now more than half are。老龄化是明确列出的问题，故 D。A 与 As fewer such workers enter the country 相反；B 与 more likely to be settled rather than migrating 相反；C 的“缺少有经验的工人”文中未提。

items.stem: What is the much-argued solution to the labor shortage in U.S. farming?
opts: To attract younger laborers to farm work.
To get native U.S. workers back to farming.
To use more robots to grow high-value crops.
To strengthen financial support for farmers.
items.exp: 定位第三段末句 One oft-debated cure for this labor shortage... Native U.S. workers won't be returning to the farm。被反复讨论的方案正是“让本土工人回到农场”，作者随即用 implausible 否定了它，故 B。A 是由“老龄化”推出的想当然，文中未作为方案讨论；C 与第四段 Mechanization isn't the answer 相反；D 的财政支持全篇无据。

items.stem: Agricultural employers complain about the H-2A visa for its
items.exp: 定位第六段 The process is cumbersome, expensive, and unreliable... bureaucratic delays led the average H-2A worker to arrive on the job 22 days late。抱怨的核心是审批慢、到岗迟，故 A。D 是最强干扰项：有年度限额的是 H-2B（limited to 66,000 a year），H-2A 明确 has no numerical cap；B 与“让工人停留更久”的诉求相反。

items.stem: Which of the following could be the best title for this text?
items.exp: 定位末段 In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it。全文从用工短缺谈到“把农场迁往墨西哥、进口水果”，末句点出“进口食物还是进口劳工”的两难，涵盖全篇，故 B。A 的“衰落”以偏概全，文中只讲用工；C 的“被墨西哥拯救”夸大其词；D 只是第四段一个分论点。

sections.title: Text 4　塑料危机与个体责任
sections.dir: Read the text and answer the questions by choosing A, B, C or D.
sections.note: 主线：个体行动值得肯定但远远不够，作者主张靠政策做结构性改变。37 题 moral licensing 是分水岭。

paras.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic. They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day — encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.
paras.zh: 阿诺德·施瓦辛格、迪亚·米尔扎和阿德里安·格雷尼尔有话对你说：打败塑料很容易。他们是一众出演世界环境日新宣传片的名人中的几位——鼓励你，也就是消费者，把吸管、餐具这类一次性塑料必需品换掉，以对抗塑料危机。

paras.en: The key messages that have been put together for World Environment Day do include a call for governments to enact legislation to curb single-use plastics. But the overarching message is directed at individuals.
paras.zh: 为世界环境日汇总的这些核心信息中，确实包含呼吁政府立法限制一次性塑料的内容。但总体的信息指向的是个人。

paras.en: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved. On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us. They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have "done our bit" without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions - a kind of "moral licensing" that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.
paras.zh: 然而，我不放心把这件事交给个人，原因在于我们对“需要达成什么”的认识太有限。比如，自带购物袋去超市、不再用塑料吸管，单靠这些收效甚微，对我们要求也极低。它们甚至可能有害：满足了“我也尽了一份力”的心理需要，却始终没有推进到更大、更果敢、更有效的行动——这是一种“道德许可”，它安抚了我们的忧虑，也让我们不再多做，不再向掌权者多提要求。

paras.en: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.
paras.zh: 当关于环境和我们对环境之责任的讨论仍围绕购物袋和吸管打转时，我们忽略了一种权力格局：它暗示我们作为“消费者”必须可持续地消费，而不是作为“公民”去问责政府和产业界，以推动真正的系统性变革。

paras.en: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority — or even most people's. We shouldn't expect it to be. In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.
paras.zh: 必须承认，环境并不是每个人的优先事项——甚至不是多数人的。我们不该指望它是。韦尔斯利学院教授伊丽莎白·R. 德松布尔（Elizabeth R. DeSombre）在新书《为什么好人会做破坏环境的事》中指出，要集体改变大量人的行为，最好的办法是让改变成为结构性的。

paras.en: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether. India has just announced it will "eliminate all single-use plastic in the country by 2022." There are also incentive-based ways of making better environmental choices easier, such as ensuring recycling is at least as easy as trash disposal.
paras.zh: 这可能意味着推行诸如“塑料税”这样的政策，为有害环境的行为增加成本，或者干脆禁止一次性塑料。印度刚刚宣布，将“在 2022 年前消除本国所有一次性塑料”。也有以激励为基础的办法，让更环保的选择更容易做出，比如确保回收至少和处理垃圾一样方便。

paras.en: DeSombre isn't saying people should stop caring about the environment. It's just that individual actions are too slow, she says, for that to be the only, or even primary, approach to changing widespread behavior.
paras.zh: 德松布尔并不是说人们应该不再关心环境。她只是说，个人行动太慢了，不足以成为改变广泛行为的唯一途径，甚至主要途径。

paras.en: None of this is about writing off the individual. It's just about putting things into perspective. We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
paras.zh: 这一切都不是要否定个人。只是要把事情放在恰当的位置上看。我们没有时间等待。我们需要能塑造集体行动（并约束污染企业）的进步政策，也需要积极推动变革的公民。

items.stem: Some celebrities star in a new video to
opts: demand new laws on the use of plastics
urge consumers to cut the use of plastics
invite public opinion on the plastics crisis
disclose the causes of the plastics crisis
items.exp: 定位首段末句 encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery。名人视频的对象是“你，消费者”，动作是“换掉一次性塑料制品”，故 B。A 是最强干扰项：呼吁立法确在 key messages 中，但第二段紧接着说 the overarching message is directed at individuals，主体错了。

items.stem: The author is concerned that "moral licensing" may
opts: mislead us into doing worthless things
prevent us from making further efforts
items.exp: 定位第三段 moral licensing that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge。道德许可让人满足于“已尽本分”，从而不再做更多，故 B。A 的 worthless 过重——原文是 accomplish little；C 与 satisfying a need to have "done our bit" 相反，正是获得了满足感。

items.stem: By pointing out our identity "citizens", the author indicates that
opts: our focus should be shifted to community welfare
our relationship with local industries is improving
we have been actively exercising our civil rights
we should press our government to lead the combat
items.exp: 定位第四段 rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change。强调“公民”身份，是要我们问责政府、推动系统性变革，故 D。A 把 government 偷换成 community；C 与作者的批评（我们只把自己当消费者）相反；B 的“与本地产业关系改善”无据，原文是 hold industries to account。

items.stem: DeSombre argues that the best way for a collective change should be
items.exp: 定位第五段 the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural，以及第六段的征税、禁令等政策手段。结构性改变即自上而下的制度推动，故 D。A 的“双赢安排”、B 的“自我驱动机制”都寄托于个体自觉，正是作者所反对的；C 只讲降低成本，概括不了 structural。

items.stem: The author concludes that individual efforts
items.exp: 定位第七、八段 individual actions are too slow... for that to be the only, or even primary, approach，以及 We don't have time to wait。个人努力“远远不够”，故 C。A 的“过于激进”与 will accomplish little、too slow 相反；B 的“前后不一致”、D 的“不理性”都无依据，作者从未否定个人行动的正当性，只说它不够。

sections.title: Section II Part B　人名观点匹配
sections.dir: Read the following text and match each of the numbered items in the left column to its corresponding information in the right column. There are two extra choices in the right column. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (10 points)
sections.note: 先划 7 项谓语（remarks/advises/notes），再回原文找人。B 与原文相反，E 出自不在题号内的人。
subs: remarks that significant moves may pose challenges to children.
says that it is wise to leave kids in the dark about real estate decisions.
advises that home purchases should not be based only on children's opinions.
thinks that children should be given a sense of involvement in homebuying decisions.
notes that aspects like children's friends and social activities should be considered upon homebuying.
believes that homebuying decisions should be based on children's needs rather than their opinions.
assumes that many children's views on real estate are influenced by the media.
sections.intro: In choosing a new home, Camille McClain's kids have a single demand: a backyard. McClain's little ones aren't the only kids who have an opinion when it comes to housing, and in many cases youngsters' views weigh heavily on parents' real estate decisions, according to a 2018 Harris Poll survey of more than 2,000 U.S. adults. While more families buck an older-generation proclivity to leave kids in the dark about real estate decisions, realty agents and psychologists have mixed views about the financial, personal and long-term effects kids' opinions may have.
sections.tail: This advice is more relevant now than ever before, even as more parents want to embrace the ideas of their children, despite the current housing crunch.

blocks.en: The idea of involving children in a big decision is a great idea because it can help them feel a sense of control and ownership in what can be an overwhelming process, said Ryan Hooper, clinical psychologist in Chicago. "Children may face serious difficulties in coping with significant moves, especially if it removes them from their current school or support system," he said. Greg Jaroszewski, real estate broker with Gagliardo Realty Associates, said he's not convinced that kids should be involved in selecting a home - but their opinions should be considered in regards to proximity to friends and social activities, if possible.
blocks.zh: 芝加哥临床心理学家瑞安·胡珀（Ryan Hooper）说，让孩子参与重大决定是个好主意，因为这能让他们在本就令人不知所措的过程中获得一种掌控感和归属感。他说：“孩子在应对重大搬迁时可能面临严重困难，尤其是当搬迁使他们离开现在的学校或支持系统时。”加利亚多房地产公司的经纪人格雷格·雅罗舍夫斯基（Greg Jaroszewski）说，他并不认为应该让孩子参与选房——但如果可能，在离朋友和社交活动的远近方面应当考虑孩子的意见。
blocks.exp: 定位胡珀的第二句引语：孩子在应对 significant moves 时可能面临 serious difficulties，尤其是离开学校或支持系统——与 A“重大搬迁可能给孩子带来挑战”几乎逐字对应。D 是最强干扰项：胡珀上一句确实提到 a sense of control and ownership，但“被纳入决策”的完整表述在贝利（42 题）处；紧随其后的雅罗舍夫斯基讲“朋友与社交活动”，对应干扰项 E，而他不在 41–45 之列。

blocks.en: "Younger children should feel like they're choosing their home - without actually getting a choice in the matter, said Adam Bailey, real estate attorney based in New York. Asking them questions about what they like about the backyard of a potential home will make them feel like they're being included in the decision-making process, Bailey said.
blocks.zh: 纽约的房地产律师亚当·贝利（Adam Bailey）说，年幼的孩子应当觉得自己在选房子——尽管实际上他们在这种事上没有选择权。贝利说，问问他们喜欢候选房子后院的什么，会让他们觉得自己被纳入了决策过程。
blocks.exp: 定位贝利的两句话：让孩子“觉得自己在选房子”“觉得自己被纳入决策过程”，即给孩子一种参与感，故 D。A 的“重大搬迁带来挑战”出自胡珀，属串段；F 的“以满足需求取代征询意见”出自格纳（45 题）；贝利强调的是“感觉被纳入”，连“实际没有选择权”都不妨碍，重点在形式上的参与。

blocks.en: Many of the aspects of homebuying aren't a consideration for children, said Tracey Hampson, a real estate agent based in Santa Clarita, Calif. And placing too much emphasis on their opinions can ruin a fantastic home purchase. "Speaking with your children before you make a real estate decision is wise, but I wouldn't base the purchasing decision solely on their opinions," Hampson said.
blocks.zh: 加州圣克拉丽塔的房地产经纪人特蕾西·汉普森（Tracey Hampson）说，买房的许多方面根本不是孩子会考虑的事；而过分看重他们的意见，可能毁掉一次极好的购房。汉普森说：“在做置业决定前与孩子谈一谈是明智的，但我不会把购房决定仅仅建立在他们的意见之上。”
blocks.exp: 定位汉普森引语中 but 之后的部分：I wouldn't base the purchasing decision solely on their opinions，与 C“购房不应只依据孩子的意见”完全对应（solely = only）。B 是反向干扰：原文说“事先与孩子商量是明智的”，B 却说“不让孩子知情才明智”，意思相反；F 把“不能只依据意见”拔高成“只按需求决定”，超出了原话。

blocks.en: The other issue is that many children — especially older ones — may base their real estate knowledge on HGTV shows, said Aaron Norris of The Norris Group in Riverside, Calif. "They love Chip and Joanna Gaines just as much as the rest of us," he said. "HGTV has seriously changed how people view real estate. It's not shelter, it's a lifestyle. With that mindset change come some serious money consequences." Kids tend to get stuck in the features and the immediate benefits to them personally, Norris said.
blocks.zh: 加州里弗赛德市诺里斯集团的亚伦·诺里斯（Aaron Norris）说，另一个问题是许多孩子——尤其是年龄较大的孩子——对房产的认识可能来自 HGTV 的节目。他说：“他们和我们一样喜欢奇普和乔安娜·盖恩斯。HGTV 已经严重改变了人们看待房产的方式。它不再是栖身之所，而是一种生活方式。观念一变，就会带来一些严重的金钱后果。”诺里斯说，孩子往往只停留在房子的特色和对自己的眼前好处上。
blocks.exp: 定位诺里斯的第一句：孩子的房产知识 based on HGTV shows，而 HGTV 已改变人们看待房产的方式——电视节目即“媒体”，故 G（views on real estate are influenced by the media）。A、C 的谓语（remarks/advises）与“受媒体影响”这一判断无关；D 的“参与感”属贝利，属于用熟悉词设的干扰。

blocks.en: Parents need to remind their children that their needs and desires may change over time, said Julie Gurner, a real estate analyst with FitSmallBusiness.com. "Their opinions can change tomorrow," Gurner said. "Harsh as it may be to say, that decision should likely not be made contingent on a child's opinions, but rather made for them with great consideration into what home can meet their needs best - and give them an opportunity to customize it a bit and make it their own."
blocks.zh: FitSmallBusiness.com 的房地产分析师朱莉·格纳（Julie Gurner）说，父母需要提醒孩子，他们的需求和愿望会随时间改变。格纳说：“他们的意见明天就可能变。说来也许残酷，但这个决定很可能不该取决于孩子的意见，而应替他们做出，并充分考虑哪种房子最能满足他们的需求——同时给他们一点机会去改造，让房子真正成为他们自己的。”
blocks.exp: 定位格纳引语中的 not... but rather 结构：决定不应 contingent on a child's opinions，而应替他们做出，并充分考虑 what home can meet their needs best——即以“需求”取代“意见”，故 F。C 只说“不能只依据意见”，仍给孩子意见留了分量；F 更进一步，这正是两人的关键差别，也是最易混的一处。

sections.title: Section III　翻译
sections.dir: Translate the following text into Chinese. Write your translation on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)
sections.note: 按句给分：先切句、再定主谓、后调语序。插入语 having a go at the writing game 是最大难点。

paras.en: It is easy to underestimate English writer James Herriot. He had such a pleasant, readable style that one might think that anyone could imitate it. How many times have I heard people say, "I could write a book. I just haven't the time." Easily said. Not so easily done. James Herriot, contrary to popular opinion, did not find it easy in his early days of, as he put it, "having a go at the writing game". While he obviously had an abundance of natural talent, the final, polished work that he gave to the world was the result of years of practicing, re-writing and reading. Like the majority of authors, he had to suffer many disappointments and rejections along the way, but these made him all the more determined to succeed. Everything he achieved in life was earned the hard way and his success in the literary field was no exception.
paras.zh: 人们很容易低估英国作家詹姆斯·赫里奥特（James Herriot）。他的文风如此亲切易读，以至于让人觉得谁都能模仿。我听过多少人这样说：“我也能写本书，只是没时间。”说起来容易，做起来却没那么容易。与流行看法相反，詹姆斯·赫里奥特在早年——用他的话说——“试着玩玩写作这一行”的时候，并不觉得轻松。他显然拥有丰富的天赋，但最终呈现给世人的那些打磨精良的作品，都是多年练习、反复修改和大量阅读的结果。和大多数作家一样，他一路不得不承受许多失望与退稿，但这些反而使他更加坚定地要取得成功。他一生所获得的一切都是靠艰苦努力挣来的，他在文学领域的成功也不例外。

sections.title: Section IV Part A　应用文（建议信）
sections.dir: Suppose Professor Smith asked you to plan a debate on the theme of city traffic. Write him an email to 1) suggest a specific topic with your reasons, and 2) tell him about your arrangements. (about 100 words)
sections.note: 两个任务点都要落地：①一个具体辩题 + 理由 ②时间、地点、形式安排。署名固定 Li Ming，不写地址。
sections.sample:
Dear Professor Smith,

I am writing to suggest a topic for the debate on city traffic that we are planning.

My proposal is "Should private cars be restricted in the city centre?" It is closely tied to our daily life and divides opinion sharply: restrictions may ease congestion and cut emissions, yet they also bring inconvenience to families and small businesses. Such a clash should make for a lively debate.

As for the arrangements, I suggest we meet in Room 302 of the library on Friday, 15 March, from 2 to 4 p.m. Two teams of four will each speak for eight minutes, followed by a free discussion. I will invite two teachers as judges and prepare the materials.

I look forward to your comments.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
tips: 开头一句点明写信目的：为城市交通主题的辩论推荐题目，不要写成通知或说明
辩题要“可分正反、有争议”，并各给一句对立立场，理由才站得住，也顺势完成了 reason 这一要求
第二问是 arrangements：时间、地点、赛制、评委都要写具体，漏掉这一块直接扣分
结尾一句请对方指正，语气正式；署名固定 Li Ming，不写地址

sections.title: Section IV Part B　图表作文
sections.dir: Write an essay based on the chart below. 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments. (about 150 words)
sections.sample:
The bar chart compares the destinations of undergraduates from a certain university in 2013 and 2018. Employment remained the dominant choice, though its share fell from 68.1% to 60.7%. By contrast, the proportion of graduates continuing their studies rose markedly, from 26.3% to 34.0%, while those starting their own businesses edged up from 1.3% to 2.6%.

Two trends stand out. First, the five years saw a clear shift from working to studying: nearly eight percentage points moved out of employment, and most of that went into postgraduate education. Second, entrepreneurship, though growing fast in relative terms, still accounts for a tiny fraction of graduates, which suggests that starting a business remains a minority option.

In my view, this change is largely driven by the job market. As a bachelor's degree no longer guarantees a decent position, more students choose further study to gain an edge, and both governments and universities have encouraged self-employment with preferential policies. Students should nevertheless weigh the cost of another degree against real work experience.
tips: 第一段只做“读数”：三组数据、两个年份，突出“一降两升”，不要插入评论
第二段做对比：就业降了 7.4 个百分点、升学升了 7.7 个百分点，两者几乎对冲，是“结构转移”的最好证据
第三段给归因与判断：就业市场竞争 + 政策鼓励创业，末句一句提醒即可，不要再开新论点
